id: \rI love coming here and finding new friends.
en: \rI love coming here and finding new friends.
it: \rAdoro venire qui a trovare nuovi amici.

id: \rMy favorite Pokémon is Yamask. If only there were more of them.
en: \rMy favorite Pokémon is Yamask. If only there were more of them.
it: \rIl mio Pokémon preferito è Yamask. Se solo ce ne fossero di più.

id: \bHow do people climb these stairs?
en: \bHow do people climb these stairs?
it: \bMa come fa la gente a salire queste scale?

id: \bI need to take a break.
en: \bI need to take a break.
it: \bHo bisogno di una pausa.

id: \bHeading to Stow-on-Side?
en: \bHeading to Stow-on-Side?
it: \bVai a Stow-on-Side?

id: \bWatch your step out here.
en: \bWatch your step out here.
it: \bAttento a dove metti i piedi qui fuori.

id: \rI've discovered a rare fossil Pokémon. I don't need it anymore though. Would you take it for me?
en: \rI've discovered a rare fossil Pokémon. I don't need it anymore though. Would you take it for me?
it: \rHo scoperto un raro Pokémon fossile. Però non mi serve più. Lo prenderesti tu per me?

id: \rVery well.
en: \rVery well.
it: \rD'accordo.

id: \rI'm working on finding Galar fossils to bring back to life.
en: \rI'm working on finding Galar fossils to bring back to life.
it: \rSto cercando fossili di Galar da riportare in vita.

id: \rTake to my assistant if you want to take any we no longer need.
en: \rTake to my assistant if you want to take any we no longer need.
it: \rParla con il mio assistente se vuoi prendere quelli che non ci servono più.

id: \rDo you know Bea?
en: \rDo you know Bea?
it: \rConosci Fabia?

id: \rBea's trained all over the world. I heard she spent some time in Johto.
en: \rBea's trained all over the world. I heard she spent some time in Johto.
it: \rFabia si è allenata in tutto il mondo. Ho sentito che ha passato un po' di tempo a Johto.

id: \bWe're working to find ancient Pokémon that went extinct.
en: \bWe're working to find ancient Pokémon that went extinct.
it: \bStiamo cercando di trovare Pokémon antichi ormai estinti.

id: \bWe recently revived an Dracozolt. Would you like it?
en: \bWe recently revived an Dracozolt. Would you like it?
it: \bAbbiamo appena riportato in vita un Dracozolt. Lo vuoi?

id: \bCome back if you change your mind.
en: \bCome back if you change your mind.
it: \bTorna se cambi idea.

id: \rHave you seen the little soldier Pokémon?
en: \rHave you seen the little soldier Pokémon?
it: \rHai visto i piccoli Pokémon soldato?

id: \rI find them adorable. They always have a leader in charge of them.
en: \rI find them adorable. They always have a leader in charge of them.
it: \rLi trovo adorabili. Hanno sempre un capo che li guida.

id: \rStow-on-Side is up ahead.
en: \rStow-on-Side is up ahead.
it: \rStow-on-Side è più avanti.

id: \rThe city is worth the visit. So much history.
en: \rThe city is worth the visit. So much history.
it: \rLa città merita una visita. Ha così tanta storia.
